interface.title: Exoplanet Transit Classifier (Dash dashboard)
interface.field: Astronomy / exoplanet detection (Kepler light curves, deep learning)
interface.stage_of_work: Reviewing a trained classifier's outputs and choosing candidates for follow-up observation
interface.what_it_is_for: A one-page dashboard for checking a Dual-View CNN's performance on Kepler transit candidates. It ranks the candidates by a scientific priority score, lets you search, sort and export them, and shows any single candidate's prediction, a plain-language explanation and its global and local light curves.

data.note: Everything ships with the app: 943 Kepler samples (609 predicted planet_transit, 334 false_positive), candidate_ranking.csv, processed .npz light curves, and static PNGs for the confusion matrix, ROC, PR curve and architecture. Nothing was uploaded. The ranking table on the page holds only the top 20 rows. The downloaded CSV has the full ranking (about 103 KB, around 943 rows); the run confirmed this from the browser's download log (trace steps 62–63), not from a screenshot. Mismatches seen: the KPI card says ROC-AUC 0.8424 while the ROC image says AUC=0.8126 (screens/001.webp, screens/039.webp). For the same candidate, the Explorer's scientific score (76.21/100) differs from the table's 0.8405 (screens/030.webp vs screens/020.webp).

features.name: Single-item inspector with auto-generated explanation
features.general: Pick one item from a long searchable list. The panel then shows its predicted class, confidence, composite score and key measured properties as cards, plus a bulleted plain-language explanation built from rules over those values.
features.specific: In the Candidate Explorer dropdown, search for a Kepler .npz candidate. The Prediction Summary cards (Prediction, Confidence, Scientific Score with a star rating, SNR, Period, Duration, Depth) and the 🧠 Scientific Model Insights bullets update for it.
steps: open the searchable dropdown
type part of the KOI ID (e.g. K01332)
click a match, or use ArrowDown and Enter
read the class, confidence, score and property cards
read the insight bullets and the overall assessment
optionally press × to clear (the last result stays displayed)
serves_tasks: Select one item and read its prediction and plain-language explanation
Contrast several items' predictions with their explanations and signals to spot inconsistencies

features.name: Paired global/local light-curve viewer
features.general: Show two linked views of one item's processed signal side by side: the whole folded series and a close-up window, each with zoom, pan, hover readout, autoscale and PNG export, so you can check by eye whether the signal matches the prediction.
features.specific: The Global Transit View (201 folded bins) and the Local Transit View (61 bins) redraw whenever a candidate is selected. Plotly zoom, pan, zoom in/out, autoscale and 'Download plot as a PNG' are available. The PNG download was confirmed from the browser's download log; the replay's success toast is check/screens/022.webp.
steps: select a candidate
drag-zoom a region of the global curve
hover a dip for its (bin, flux) value
zoom in or pan the local curve
press Autoscale to reset
download as PNG
serves_tasks: Visually check the signal in the item's folded, binned signal views
Save a figure of the inspected data

features.name: Filterable, sortable ranked table with CSV export
features.general: A results table with a filter box in every column (text match or numeric comparisons such as >20), a case-sensitivity toggle, sorting on any column (ascending or descending), and a button that exports the full ranked dataset.
features.specific: In the Candidate Rankings DataTable (rank, file, prediction, confidence, scientific_score, period_days, duration_hours, depth_ppm, snr), use the 'filter data...' boxes and the 'Aa' toggles, sort with the header arrows, and press ⬇ Download Ranked Candidates (.csv). The export is the full candidate_ranking.csv, not the filtered view. The download was confirmed from the browser's download log; the replay's capture of it is check/screens/015.webp.
steps: type a value or a comparison (e.g. >20) in a column filter
press the Aa toggle to switch case sensitivity
click a sort arrow (once ascending, twice descending)
clear the filter
press Download to export the CSV
serves_tasks: Search, filter and sort the ranked candidate table
Export the ranked list for offline analysis

features.name: Class-coloured confidence vs score scatter with legend isolation and box select
features.general: Plot each item's model confidence against its composite score, coloured by predicted class. Hover for IDs, hide or isolate a class from the legend, and box- or lasso-select a group of outliers.
features.specific: The 'Prediction Confidence vs Scientific Score' scatter (planet_transit vs false_positive). Hover shows the file, confidence and score. Double-clicking a legend entry isolates that class. Box Select highlights the chosen points (the selection is not passed to the table or the Explorer).
steps: hover an outlying point to read its candidate ID
double-click a legend entry to isolate a class
choose Box Select
drag a box around the points of interest
serves_tasks: Compare confidence against the priority score and find outliers

features.name: Dataset-level prediction distribution panels
features.general: Summarise a classifier's output over the whole dataset with a class-share pie (legend toggles hide or show classes) and a confidence histogram that you can drag-zoom to read bin counts.
features.specific: The 'Distribution of Predicted Classes' pie and the 'Prediction Confidence Distribution' histogram. Click a legend entry to hide a class, drag-zoom the histogram tail, hover a bin for its count, then Reset axes.
steps: read the class shares on the pie
click a legend entry to hide or show a class
drag-zoom a range of the confidence histogram
hover a bin for its count
press Reset axes
serves_tasks: See how the model splits items between the two classes
Inspect the spread of model confidence scores

features.name: Ranked top-N priority bar charts with multi-attribute hover
features.general: Show the highest-scoring items as ranked bars of a composite priority score. Hovering a bar shows the item's ID and score, or in the top-10 chart its confidence and measured properties together, so you can shortlist without opening each item.
features.specific: The 'Highest Scientific Priority' (top 20) and 'Top 10 Planet Transit' bar charts. Hover a bar for the file and scientific score; in the Top 10 chart the tooltip adds confidence, SNR, period, duration and depth. Clicking a bar does not open the candidate in the Explorer.
steps: read the order of the top-20 priority bars
hover a bar for its candidate ID and score
hover a Top 10 bar for confidence, SNR, period, duration and depth
serves_tasks: See which items score highest on the composite priority score

features.name: Model-evaluation summary panel
features.general: Summarise a trained classifier's quality with headline metric cards, a per-metric bar chart you can hover for exact values, and static diagnostic figures (confusion matrix, ROC and precision-recall curves) beside them.
features.specific: The KPI cards (samples, predicted planets, predicted false positives, ROC–AUC), the Model Performance Metrics bar chart (Validation Accuracy, ROC-AUC, Planet Precision, Recall, F1) and the static confusion matrix, ROC (AUC=0.8126) and PR (AP=0.8585) images. The KPI ROC–AUC (0.8424) disagrees with the ROC image (0.8126).
steps: read the KPI cards
hover each metric bar for its value
scroll to the confusion matrix, ROC and PR images
compare the AUC on the card with the one on the ROC image
serves_tasks: Read the summary performance scores of the model
Inspect diagnostic curves and the error breakdown

screens_never_reached: The table has no second page or 'show all' option. Only the top 20 ranked candidates are in the on-page table, so lower-ranked ones can be searched only in the Explorer dropdown or in the downloaded CSV.
not_done: Opening a candidate from the table or the ranking charts in the Explorer: clicking a table cell (screens/026.webp) or the top priority bar (screens/014.webp) does not change the Explorer. Candidates must be re-picked in its dropdown.
Selections do not cross panels: a Box Select on the scatter does not filter the table or the Explorer (screens/019.webp, screens/020.webp).

The confusion matrix, ROC and PR curves are static images, so they cannot be inspected beyond viewing. The confusion matrix shows no numbers in its cells and has odd ±0.5 axis ticks instead of class labels.
The 'Share chart...' toolbar buttons, the GitHub link and the Live Dashboard link point off-site, so I did not open them.
The snr column's cell values looked blank in the screenshots when the table was scrolled sideways (screens/022.webp, screens/047.webp), but the accessibility snapshot shows the values are there.

The explanation text sometimes contradicts the prediction: a candidate labelled False Positive gets 'Overall Assessment: This candidate appears highly promising...' (screens/044.webp). I recorded this but did not investigate further.

For the known planet K00002.01, the deep transit dip sits near bin 175 of the global view and does not appear in the local view (screens/035.webp). I noted this possible preprocessing or centring issue but could not confirm its cause from the browser.

Resetting the global view by double-click is not shown: the trace has only a single click on the plot (step 78) and no screenshot, and the replay did not try it. Autoscale was used as the reset instead.
Neither download (CSV, PNG) was captured in this run's screenshots; both were confirmed only from the browser's download log.
